basic_info.description: Rare top-floor opportunity! This spacious one-bedroom home at Park Terrace is flooded with natural light through oversized windows, offering serene waterfront views. The large bedroom features a walk-in closet, and the open layout includes a private balcony, granite counters, stainless appliances, and hardwood floors. Park Terrace recently completed a full renovation of all common areas. Enjoy a fresh, modern building! Amenities include fitness center, BBQ courtyard, on-site management, and secure entry. Live steps from Mission Bays best: Oracle Park, Guss Market, Mission Bay library, Caltrain, Muni, parks, cafes, and waterfront trails. Opportunities like this in Mission Bays waterfront community don't come often!
